تستمجدون (form X)
# تَسْتَمْجِدُونَ (tastamjidūna) /tas.tam.d͡ʒi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# تُسْتَمْجَدُونَ (tustamjadūna) /tus.tam.d͡ʒa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
